text:
alex: heads up — customer bridge reports missing pages for svc-bridge-prod 11:42 UTC. Incidentbot did NOT page primary on the first failure, looks like it only sent a shadow fanout to the monitoring queue. @maria @sam can you confirm?

maria: omg saw that. i got the shadow messages in the debug stream but no actual pager. 11:42-11:44 spike.

sam: i'm on it. checking incidentbot logs and routing rules now.

ops-bot: Incidentbot delivery status: shadow_fanout=45, primary_fanout=0, queue_enqueue=FAILED (code=202?) — automated alert created.

alex: customer impact: some customers on the SMS fallback reported 2 min delay, one escalated to support with "no alert" message. Could be missing live handoff.

jordan: i'm seeing a header strip in the webhook proxy logs: `X-Incident-ID` absent on primary route but present for shadow. that would cause the enqueue to bypass the primary worker.

sam: paste of tail of logs: ```
[2026-03-18T11:42:07Z] incidentbot: fanout to shadow queue ok id=inc_12345
[2026-03-18T11:42:07Z] incidentbot: attempt primary enqueue -> proxy POST /enqueue returned 202 but body="ok" and no X-Incident-ID forwarded
[2026-03-18T11:42:08Z] enqueue-worker: drop missing-metadata incident=inc_12345 reason="missing-id"
```

maria: that explains no paging. primary path had header removal by the proxy's `suppress_headers` rule for a subset of routes after yesterday's deploy. shadow path goes directly to monitoring queue, so it still had the id.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) manually page oncall for affected customers now, 2) revert suppress_headers rule (hotfix) to restore id forwarding, 3) add an emergency check to incidentbot to fail open if enqueue returns 202 but response lacks id.

sam: manual page sent to oncall-rotation (confirmed). paging notes: manual page included incident id and customer list.

ops-bot: Manual page acknowledged by oncall @jordan :white_check_mark:.

jordan: oncall is triaging. can one of you revert the proxy rule? i'll hold customer bridge open until pages stop dropping.

maria: rolling back rule now — `/deploy proxy --rollback suppress_headers-2026-03-17`

ops-bot: Deploy started by maria at 11:50 UTC.

alex: also adding a temporary safeguard: incident-assistant, can you enable a replay gate that re-enqueues shadow messages to primary if primary returns 202 without id?

incident-assistant: temporary replay gate enabled for 30m: replay-shadow->primary on missing-id.

sam: rollback complete. running smoke: 3 test incidents -> primary fanout now 3/3, queue_enqueue success.

jordan: customer bridge shows pages delivered. support notified customers affected and offered manual callbacks.

alex: root cause summary (short): proxy suppress_headers rule trimmed X-Incident-ID for a subset of primary routes after yesterday config change. shadow fanout bypassed proxy so shadow deliveries succeeded, but primary path enqueued messages missing id were dropped by enqueue-worker. led to missing pages and 2min delays for some customers.

maria: next actions: create a postmortem, add unit test for header passthrough in proxy, add incidentbot assertion on enqueue response (must include forwarded id) and add alert if shadow_fanout > primary_fanout by >10% for 5m.

sam: filing ticket: INFRA-5631 postmortem + fixes. tagging @oncall for follow-up.

jordan: thanks team. logging RCA notes to the incident channel and paging the PM for customer outreach. :thumbsup:

alex: marking this as mitigated. will keep monitoring for 1 hour.

ops-bot: Monitoring: primary_fanout restored, shadow_replays=12, no new missing pages for 30s.

maria: quick note — include timeline and config diff in the postmortem. i captured the rollback command and the offending rule.

alex: good. thanks everyone.

sam: closing thread, will attach logs and the ticket link to the postmortem in ~30m.

jordan: confirmed customer bridge OK, closing on my side too.

ops-bot: Incident closed (manual) at 12:15 UTC.
